ty04nb5y.variantName: VeryMerry 7FT Snowhill Pre-Lit Christmas Tree with 8 Modes Timer - Warm White
ty04nb5y.sourceDescription: PRE-LIT LED TREE DÉCOR: This Snowshill Pre Lit Christmas Tree is a must-have for the festive season. Measuring at 7 feet high with a diameter of 120cm, this tree will have no problems being the centrepiece of your home over the Christmas period. Fitted with 400 warm white LED lights with 8 different light settings and a timer, this tree is sure to be the centre of attention this Christmas. LUXURY FINISH: The gorgeous ever-green tree is finished with 1115 tips to ensure that it always looks thick, bushy and plump. The tips also allow you to dress the tree with your chosen decorations with ease. Please note that some time will need to be spent arranging the tree to achieve the desired look. STURDY BASE: This festive tree comes with a sturdy metal base which ensures your tree is always fully balanced and remains in place whilst in use. The tree is made up of 3 different sections complete with hinged branches making it hassle-free to assemble, dismantle and store away. LONG-LASTING: This beautiful Christmas tree is made from high-quality PVC which not only gives the tree a more realistic look, but it also means that this tree can be used for many years due to its high durability. This product is made with fire resistant material to provide you and your home with extra safety. DIMENSIONS: This tree stands at 7 feet high and has a diameter of 120cm. WEIGHT: 12KG Please refer to the product packaging and user manual for applicable safety warnings and instructions. Consumable Direct Ltd, 78 Cawdor St, Eccles, Manchester, M30 0QF

w76hvezx.variantName: Christmas Tree World 7ft Frosted Ultra Mountain Pine Christmas Tree
w76hvezx.sourceDescription: Brr! The Frosted Ultra Mountain Pine's cool flocking effortlessly combines the Ultra Mountain Pine's realism and the wintery colour scheme of our snowy Christmas trees. The delicate flocked finish on this 7ft realistic Christmas tree creates the ultimate chilly festive experience, while the natural-looking PE branch tips will have guests believing you've just visited a real tree farm! The hinged and contoured branches are a breeze to assemble. What's more, with their signature upturned look, they're ideal for hanging Christmas decorations from, too! Picture shows 7ft tree in our range. Please note: Accessories in the images are not included with purchase. Product Features • Size: 7ft • Number of branch tips: 2640 PE/PVC branch tips • Tree width: 140cm diameter • Foliage colour: Realistic dark green with a light frosted snow effect • Realistic look: A mix of ultra-realistic plastic moulded tips, with traditional PVC tips to fill out any gaps • Easy assembly: Attached hinged branches • Sturdy base: Folding metal stand with plastic tips to prevent scratching • Indoor use only: The construction will rust in rain • Height measured from the floor • Eligible for European shipping • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. Read the operating instructions before use. Keep away from heat sources. Christmas Tree World, Unit 3, Enfield Industrial Estate, Enfield Street, Wigan, Greater Manchester, WN5 8DB, United Kingdom

hx53j8gz.baseName: Christmas Tree World 6ft Pre-Lit Wildhorn Pine Half - Warm White Lights
hx53j8gz.variantName: Christmas Tree World 6ft Pre-Lit Wildhorn Pine Half - Warm White Lights
hx53j8gz.sourceDescription: Bring a warm festive glow to your home with the stunning 6ft Pre-lit Wildhorn Pine Half Tree. Its half-tree design combines lifelike pine needle foliage with 200 multi-function warm white LED lights and a generous front profile. Measuring 105cm wide and 55cm deep, it sits neatly against a wall or in a corner, leaving more room for your Christmas celebrations. Broad lower branches and a classic, tapered shape create a full front display in rooms where floor space is limited. Short-cut pine needle outer branches and inner PVC tips add depth and fullness. Natural green shades and subtle brown detailing create a lovely backdrop for decorations. The fitted warm white LEDs highlight the foliage, with multiple lighting effects to suit your festive display. The tree comes in three sections, with flexible branches for easy shaping and a supportive metal stand. For the best results, spread the inner PVC tips before shaping the outer pine needle branches. Wear long sleeves and the included gloves when fluffing the prickly pine needles. Designed for indoor use only, with Christmas Tree World's 10-year foliage and branch guarantee and a 1-year guarantee on the lights. Please note: Accessories in the images are not included with purchase. Product Features • Size: 6ft • Pre-lit: 200 multi-function warm white LED lights • Number of branch tips: 721 • Foliage: Realistic pine needle outer branches with traditional PVC tips towards the centre for added fullness • Foliage colour: Natural green • Tree dimensions: 105cm wide × 55cm deep • Design: Half tree for positioning against a wall or in a corner • Construction: Attached flexible branches for easy positioning and shaping • Assembly: Three tree sections • Base: Metal stand measuring 55cm in diameter • Includes gloves to wear during assembly • Indoor use only • Guarantee: 10 years on foliage and branches, plus 1 year on the lights • Supplied in one carton • Carton dimensions: 96cm × 26cm × 28cm • Weight: 8.70kg • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. Read the operating instructions before use. Keep away from heat sources. Christmas Tree World, Unit 3, Enfield Industrial Estate, Enfield Street, Wigan, Greater Manchester, WN5 8DB, United Kingdom

xj0j423n.sourceDescription: Bring festive charm to your home with this 180cm pre-lit Christmas garland, featuring a lush mix of realistic green foliage, full-bodied branches, and 50 warm white LED lights for a soft seasonal glow. Designed with 133 branch tips, it offers a rich, lifelike look that instantly elevates mantels, staircases, or tabletops. Lightweight and easy to style, it's ideal for creating a cosy, elegant atmosphere throughout the festive season. Whether displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated décor theme, this garland is a beautiful, reusable piece you'll reach for year after year. Please Note: Best for indoor use and protected areas. The branches may need to be fanned out by hand after assembly to achieve the desired look. This garland requires 3x AA batteries. gj1rh5fz.sourceDescription: Add a cosy, elegant touch to your festive décor with this plush Christmas tree skirt, featuring a soft, fluffy fabric and delicate gold snowflake patterns for a luxurious seasonal look. Designed to wrap around the base of your Christmas tree, it neatly covers the tree stand and helps keep the surrounding floor tidy by catching fallen needles. The wrap-around design makes installation quick and simple, while the flexible, rollable construction allows for compact storage after the festive season, ready to reuse year after year. Suitable for most Christmas trees, this decorative tree skirt complements a range of festive interiors. Specifications: Soft plush fabric, gold snowflake pattern, wrap-around design, rollable for easy storage and helps cover the tree stand and catch fallen needles. Dimensions: Diameter: 56cm, H: 25cm. Measurements may vary by approximately 1cm due to the soft fabric. Read the operating instructions before use. Vivo Technologies Limited, Unit 11, Rainsford Road, London, NW10 7RG
